This is the DSH equivalent of Claude Code's `!` prefix."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"**When to use:**
- Quick status checks: `/! git status`, `/! npm test`

- Output is bounded (`maxOutputBytes`, tail retained) and formatted for analy"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"sis
- The command text and lifecycle are logged to the trajectory (`command/run`/`command/done`)
- R"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"equires an active model conversation (won't work on the first message before any model request)"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### `/terminal` — Interactive terminal"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"An interactive PTY popup (persistent shell, live WebSocket stream). Best for:
- **Exploratory debugg"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ing**: run multiple commands, observe behavior
- **Iterative testing**: modify → test → modify cycle"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"s
- **Multi-step operations**: setup → execute → verify workflows"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"**How it works:**"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Closing the terminal **never** sends anything to the model automatically:
- If the session never rec"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"eived input → no trace left (no file, no history entry)
- If the session received input → transcript"},{"id":"p33s3","text":" persists to `<workspace>/.dsh-shell-transcripts/`, panel jumps to History tab with the new entry pr"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"to `<workspace>/.dsh-shell-transcripts/`, panel jumps to History tab with the new entry pre-selected"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"You decide later whether to reference it for analysis (see History Tab workflow below)."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"#### Session Tab Features"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- **Line-oriented terminal**: monospace scrollback + input line
- **Control keys**: Ctrl+C/D/Z send "},{"id":"p36s2","text":"raw control bytes to the shell
- **Command history**: ArrowUp/ArrowDown recall previously-submitted "},{"id":"p36s3","text":"lines (client-side, max 500 entries)
- **Limitations**: Tab-completion not supported; full VT100/xte"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"rm (vim, htop) planned for future release"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"#### History Tab Workflow"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"When you close a terminal session that received input, the panel automatically switches to the Histo"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"u close a terminal session that received input, the panel automatically switches to the History tab:"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"**UI Elements:**
1. **Checkbox** (left): Select one or more history entries for analysis
2. **Timest"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"amp**: When each session was closed
3. **View/Collapse button** (right): Expand to preview the trans"},{"id":"p39s3","text":"cript
4. **Notes textarea** (bottom): Optional natural-language context for the model
5. **Default m"},{"id":"p39s4","text":"essage hint**: Shows what the model receives if you leave notes empty: "请帮我分别分析这些历史终端记录。"
6. **Two a"},{"id":"p39s5","text":"ction buttons**:
- **引用并分析** ("Reference & Analyze"): Send selected entries to the model for immedia"},{"id":"p39s6","text":"te analysis
- **直接退出，本次不分析** ("Exit without analyzing"): Close the panel without sending anything"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"**Typical workflow:**"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"**Advanced usage:**
